question: Where does the process of fertilization take place in the human body?
solution:
The correct answer is the__** Fallopian tube**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **process of fertilization** in the **human body involves the union of human eggs and sperm in the fallopian tube.**
 
• Later it leads to the formation of a **zygote cell or fertilizes an egg.**
 
• There is another process called** IVF** that stands for **" In Vitro fertilization".**
 
• In** IVF** the egg cells are **fertilized by the sperm outside the womb**.
 
• The process of fertilization in** human beings begins with ejaculation during copulation and ovulation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** fallopian tube** is also called a **uterine tube or salpinges.**
 
• It helps in the** transportation of ova from the ovary to the uterus.**
 
• The tube was named after the **Italian anatomist** **Gabriele Falloppio.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f1867cdaee607c1b647b9f5fd5ddeb6cfad4c5d26027a920c68ead1961a8b49.png]
